title: AOS Admin: Conclude Station Exploration
abstract: Formally concluding the station exploration project. Marking Task 19 as 'completed' and creating a new parent task (Task 21) for 'Project Metis Phase 3: The Analytical Engine'.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')

from telos import aos_manager

tasks = aos_manager.load_tasks()
# Mark Task 19 as completed
for task in tasks:
    if task['id'] == 19:
        task['status'] = 'completed'
        task['completed_tick'] = 81
aos_manager.save_tasks(tasks)
print("Task 19 (Agency Lab Review) marked as completed.")

# Create new parent task for Phase 3
aos_manager.create_task(
    parent_id=None,
    description="Project Metis Phase 3: Develop the Analytical Engine by integrating the Agency Lab framework into the AOS.",
    tick=81
)
